issues.explanation: The abbreviations table at clause 4 explicitly maps the acronym ROC → «مشخصه‌های عملیاتی گیرنده», while the proposed preferred term «مشخصه عملکرد گیرنده» comes only from the section heading at clause 6.5.5.5. When a standard's abbreviations table directly assigns an acronym to a Persian form, that explicit normative mapping takes editorial precedence over incidental heading usage in body text. The current setup effectively demotes the abbreviations-table form to 'alternative'.
issues.suggested_fix: Swap preferred and primary alternative: set preferred_fa to «مشخصه‌های عملیاتی گیرنده» (clause 4 mapping) and move «مشخصه عملکرد گیرنده» to alternatives_fa. If the editors judge the section-heading form more appropriate, add an explicit sentence in editor_note_fa justifying that choice over the table mapping.

issues.explanation: «منحنی مشخصه عملکرد گیرنده» is listed in alternatives_fa with the editor note acknowledging it was the edition-1 entry for «ROC curve» — a separate entry. Including the curve-specific form as an alias for the ROC concept proper conflates the statistical concept (ROC) with its graphical display (ROC curve), which the edition already treats as distinct.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove «منحنی مشخصه عملکرد گیرنده» from alternatives_fa and instead add a cross-reference note: «برای منحنی ROC، نگاه کنید به مدخل ROC curve».

issues.explanation: «AIMS» appears in both the acronym field and in alternatives_fa. An English acronym is not a Persian alternative form. Its presence in alternatives_fa could mislead users into treating it as a Persian-language spelling variant rather than the Latin abbreviation already captured in the dedicated acronym field.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove «AIMS» from alternatives_fa; retain it only in the acronym field.
